_doc: Brain tuning. dwell=forced pause after each action (s); lookahead=missions in flight; flex=extra slots for parallel work; skip=chance of a worse-but-legal job; max_orders=tickets fed to the planner; idle_wait=stand still after a dish lands (s); sprint=hold sprint on long walks; burn_urgent=seconds on a hot plate that force a rescue; hand_timeout=seconds before a held item nothing wants is binned; turn_slack=px inside a tile still counted as aligned; stuck=seconds of no progress before a mission is dropped; cooldown=seconds that dish is skipped after being dropped; preheat=steam the next rice before its ticket lands; nearest=bias legal jobs towards the player's side of the kitchen; clash=seconds of penalty for reusing a busy machine.
